items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: when Patsy would come in at night, I'd meet him at the door... you would ask Pat, or Patsy, what you want tonight?

ctx.x: I can't think of Tip-A-Lite's name now. Uh-huh. But anyhow, he sang the blues. In those days, the blues singers was Tip-A-Lite, Joe August, who was named Google Eyes, Roy Brown, Fats Domino was just getting started. Um, Lloyd Ignatius, um, um, Patsy Vildar was the toast of the town. Yeah, sure. Miss Patsy. Yeah, well, you see, when I played at the do drop for Frank, and so forth, and I used to sometimes do the announcing about who was coming up. But before you get started on the night, before the night started,…
Uh, reel number three with Milton Batiste on February 5th, 1997. Okay.
